title: Pure Millennium
summary: Pure Millennium control and Exodia fusion deck, assembling Ancient Egyptian stone slabs and the five Forbidden One pieces to summon The Unstoppable Exodia Incarnate. Millennium monsters place themselves in the Spell & Trap Zone as Continuous Spells and Special Summon themselves by paying 2000 LP or revealing Millennium Ankh, converting LP into massive bodies and searching the combo.

summary.title: Starters
points: Wedju Temple places a Millennium monster from your Deck face-up into your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell.
Sengenjin Wakes from a Millennium places itself into the Spell & Trap Zone, summons itself from the backrow, and searches a Millennium monster like Heart of Gaia or Shield of the Millennium Dynasty.
Shield of the Millennium Dynasty places itself into the Spell & Trap Zone, summons itself, and searches Millennium Ankh or Wedju Temple.
Heart of the Blue-Eyes is always treated as a Millennium card, discarding itself from the hand to search Millennium Ankh.

summary.title: Opening: Wedju Temple + Sengenjin
steps: Activate Wedju Temple, placing Shield of the Millennium Dynasty from your Deck into your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell.
Activate Sengenjin Wakes from a Millennium in hand to place itself into your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell.
Pay 2000 LP to Special Summon Sengenjin, triggering its effect to search Heart of Gaia or Golem that Guards the Millennium Treasures from your Deck.
Pay 2000 LP to Special Summon Shield of the Millennium Dynasty, searching Millennium Ankh.
Activate Millennium Ankh, revealing the five Forbidden One pieces from hand or Deck to Fusion Summon The Unstoppable Exodia Incarnate.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: The Unstoppable Exodia Incarnate cannot be destroyed by card effects, gains ATK equal to your LP, negates the activation of an opponent's Spell or Trap Card once per turn, and Sets Exxod Fires of Rage directly from your Deck.

Heart of Gaia can be Normal Summoned without Tributing next to a Level 5 or higher monster, increases the Level of Attack Position monsters your opponent summons by 7, and sends a face-up Level 5 or higher monster to the GY to negate an opponent's monster effect.
Golem that Guards the Millennium Treasures makes Millennium Ankh's activation and effects unnegatable, and searches Wedju Temple.

Maiden of the Millennium Moon and Fiend Reflection of the Millennium place themselves into the Spell & Trap Zone and Special Summon themselves when the opponent activates cards, providing protection and LP recovery.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Millennium Ankh reveals the five Forbidden One pieces from your hand, Deck, and field to Special Summon The Unstoppable Exodia Incarnate directly from your Extra Deck.
Wedju Temple places Millennium monsters directly from your Deck into your backrow each turn and recovers Millennium cards from the GY when a monster is destroyed.
Exxod Fires of Rage is a Quick-Play Spell Set directly by The Unstoppable Exodia Incarnate that destroys all cards your opponent controls while you control a Level 10 or higher Exodia monster.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The five Forbidden One pieces (Exodia the Forbidden One, Left Arm, Left Leg, Right Arm, and Right Leg) are Limited to 1 in the TCG and serve solely as reveals for Millennium Ankh rather than an alternate win condition.
